title: Responsive status dashboard
user_prompt: Build a terminal dashboard for three background services. Show each service's current status, latency, last update, and a short activity summary. One service has no latency sample yet and one has a long name containing a wide Unicode character. Make the layout useful at 40x12, 80x24, and 120x40 terminal sizes. Keep the primary problem and service states easy to scan.

acceptance_checks.assertion: At 40x12, every service's identity and status remain discoverable and the layout does not rely on horizontal overflow.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Captured output at 40x12 with service labels and statuses visible.

acceptance_checks.assertion: At 80x24 and 120x40, available space improves scanning without changing the meaning or ordering of status information.
Every status remains distinguishable without color alone.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Rendered text labels or symbols plus a monochrome review.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Missing latency is shown as unknown/not yet sampled and is not silently converted to zero.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Assertion or recorded output for the missing-latency case.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Layout calculations use display-cell width or Termina layout primitives rather than JavaScript string length.

hard_gates.failure_condition: The implementation uses undocumented or nonexistent Termina exports/props without verifying them.
The report claims terminal sizes or checks were exercised when no evidence was collected.
